the_day: Anthropic's updated IPO filing and a Google-backed data center deal for Anthropic led the day. OpenAI agreed to buy Pierre and added GIFs to ChatGPT, Google set new AI defaults for students, xAI reportedly cut Grok Bot limits, and Meta was quiet.

items.headline: Anthropic's updated IPO filing shows $17 billion in quarterly revenue
points: Anthropic's new IPO filing reports $17 billion in quarterly revenue and continued losses, the Jamaica Gleaner reports.
Outlets give different loss figures. FourWeekMBA says 91% of the loss is a fair-value remeasurement.
Barron's reports the filing shows Anthropic's seven founders will take majority control of the business.
